subproblem.title: Dilation change of variables for H^n set integrals over blow-up images η_{x,r}(M)
subproblem.statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, x ∈ ℝ^N (= Euclidean N) and r > 0. Let M ⊆ ℝ^N be an arbitrary set and F : ℝ^N → ℝ an arbitrary function. Let η := Chapter03.blowUpMap x r, so η(y) = r⁻¹ • (y − x), and let H^n := μHE[n]. Then ∫_{η(M)} F dH^n = r⁻¹^n · ∫_M F(η(z)) dH^n(z), as Bochner set integrals. No measurability or integrability of M or F is assumed.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (x : Euclidean N) (r : ℝ) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (F : Euclidean N → ℝ), 0 < r → ∫ y in Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M, F y ∂μHE[n] = r⁻¹ ^ n * ∫ z in M, F (Chapter03.blowUpMap x r z) ∂μHE[n]
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 1 of the selected proof (Simon Ch. 3, Remark 1.8(2)), the change of variables (∗), here for arbitrary M and F. Provenance (orientation only): the same argument was accepted on another DAG branch for an identically typed lemma named frt_wat_setIntegral_blowUpMap_image. That declaration is not available on this branch and its name is reserved there. Do not reference it; prove this child under its own name exactly as below. The proof is self-contained.

Notation: H := μHE[n]; η := Chapter03.blowUpMap x r, so η(y) = r⁻¹ • (y − x) (the definition unfolds by rfl); ψ(y) := x + r • y. All integrals are Bochner integrals, and nothing is assumed about M or F.

1. η is a homeomorphism of ℝ^N with inverse ψ. Since r ≠ 0, ψ(η(y)) = x + r • (r⁻¹ • (y − x)) = x + (y − x) = y and η(ψ(y)) = r⁻¹ • ((x + r • y) − x) = r⁻¹ • (r • y) = y. Both maps are continuous, being built from translations and scalings. Hence η is a measurable embedding (Homeomorph.measurableEmbedding) and is injective. In Lean one may take η := (Homeomorph.subRight x).trans (Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero r⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero hr.ne')), whose underlying function is Chapter03.blowUpMap x r by rfl.

2. Scaling of H under η⁻¹. Let S ⊆ ℝ^N be any set, not necessarily measurable. Since ψ inverts η, η⁻¹(S) = ψ(S) = τ(r • S), where τ(y) := x + y and r • S := {r • s : s ∈ S}. τ is an isometry (isometry_add_left), so H(τ(r • S)) = H(r • S) (Isometry.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_image). Since r ≠ 0, H(r • S) = ‖r‖₊^n • H(S) (MeasureTheory.Measure.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_smul₀). As r > 0, the [0, ∞]-valued factor ‖r‖₊^n equals ENNReal.ofReal(r)^n = ENNReal.ofReal(r^n) (enorm_eq_nnnorm, Real.enorm_eq_ofReal, ENNReal.ofReal_pow). Therefore H(η⁻¹(S)) = ENNReal.ofReal(r^n) · H(S).

3. Pushforward of H. For every Borel S, (H.map η)(S) = H(η⁻¹(S)) (Measure.map_apply; η is continuous, hence measurable). By step 2 this equals ENNReal.ofReal(r^n) · H(S) = (ENNReal.ofReal(r^n) • H)(S). By Measure.ext, H.map η = ENNReal.ofReal(r^n) • H.

4. Pushforward of H⌞M. Since η is a measurable embedding, MeasurableEmbedding.restrict_map gives (H.map η).restrict(η(M)) = (H.restrict(η⁻¹(η(M)))).map η, and η⁻¹(η(M)) = M by injectivity (Set.preimage_image_eq). Combining this with step 3 and Measure.restrict_smul:
 (H.restrict M).map η = (H.map η).restrict(η(M)) = (ENNReal.ofReal(r^n) • H).restrict(η(M)) = ENNReal.ofReal(r^n) • H.restrict(η(M)).

5. Change of variables. Because η is a measurable embedding, ∫ G d(ν.map η) = ∫ G(η(z)) dν(z) for every measure ν and every function G : ℝ^N → ℝ (MeasurableEmbedding.integral_map; G need not be measurable). Take ν := H.restrict M and G := F. Then use step 4 and integral_smul_measure (∫ G d(c • ν') = c.toReal · ∫ G dν'):
 ∫_M F(η(z)) dH(z) = ∫ F d((H.restrict M).map η) = (ENNReal.ofReal(r^n)).toReal · ∫_{η(M)} F dH = r^n · ∫_{η(M)} F dH.
 The last step is ENNReal.toReal_ofReal, using r^n ≥ 0.

6. Since r⁻¹^n · r^n = (r⁻¹ · r)^n = 1, multiplying the identity of step 5 by r⁻¹^n gives r⁻¹^n · ∫_M F(η(z)) dH(z) = ∫_{η(M)} F dH. Here η(M) = Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' M and F(η(z)) = F (Chapter03.blowUpMap x r z), so this is exactly the claim. ∎
proof_key_steps: η = blowUpMap x r is a homeomorphism with inverse y ↦ x + r • y, hence an injective measurable embedding.
For every set S, H^n(η⁻¹ S) = H^n(x + r • S) = r^n H^n(S) (translation isometry and Measure.euclideanHausdorffMeasure_smul₀).
H^n.map η = ENNReal.ofReal(r^n) • H^n (Measure.ext on Borel sets).
(H^n⌞M).map η = ENNReal.ofReal(r^n) • H^n⌞η(M) (MeasurableEmbedding.restrict_map, η⁻¹(η M) = M, Measure.restrict_smul).
MeasurableEmbedding.integral_map and integral_smul_measure give ∫_M F∘η dH^n = r^n ∫_{η(M)} F dH^n; multiply by r⁻¹^n.
